simple.meaning: קְנָא (qᵉnâʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to purchase.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Ezra, beginning at Ezra 7:17. Its contexts include offering, altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְנָא (H7066).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קְנָא (qᵉnâʼ) / H7066 is traced through Ezra 7:17 as a generated source-based concept entry.
